title: Audit cleanup (low priority): Kanbus
description:
**Problem**
Low-severity findings from the 2026-10-20 audit of Kanbus and Kanbus-web.

**Evidence / Fix** (one checklist line per finding)
- [ ] [Kanbus-web] https://kanb.us/docs/features/integrated-wiki/ and https://kanb.us/docs/features/git-native-storage/ return 404; fix or remove the links that point to them.
- [ ] [Kanbus-web] README says papyrus version X while the repo uses another (version mismatch), and says the site is live at kanb.us though the cutover is pending (see c3e738); correct both.
- [ ] [Kanbus-web] Content links could not be verified until a Markus build exists; run a link check after the first build.
- [ ] docs/GITHUB_SYNC.md:12,31 contain the placeholder `<blob-url>` (template text left in); replace with the real URL or explain it.
- [ ] videos/docs/VIDEOS_* docs reference stale paths; update to current paths.

**How to verify**
`curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://kanb.us/docs/features/integrated-wiki/` returns 200 (or no page links to it); `grep -n '<blob-url>' docs/GITHUB_SYNC.md` returns nothing; every path named in videos/docs/VIDEOS_* exists.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
